We the Student Welfare Division value originality and creativity backed up by planned and coherent team action. We are conscientious about virtually everything concerned with your stay here. To facilitate a pleasant environment, we take care of various aspects of student welfare like housing, financial aid & scholarships, health - care, games & sports maintenance of student dues, cultural activities and student counseling. The Institute is fully residential, and all students are provided hostel accommodation. Permission to become a day scholar may be granted only The Institute is fully residential, and all students are provided hostel accommodation. Permission to become a day scholar may be granted only under exceptional circumstances where the student's parents or relatives are Pilani residents. Facilities in the Hostels: There are eleven hostels for boys and one hostel complex for girls. The hostel rooms are fully furnished. Common room facilities with Cable TV and telephone are available in each hostel. Internet connectivity has been provided in all hostel rooms. Solar water heating systems are provided in all the hostels. More details can be found here. Hostel allotment: The allotment is done through a random process through an algorithm. The details are given here. For the specially-abled students, we provide accommodation on the hostel's ground floor on request to Chief Warden. Mess: There is a shared kitchen cum mess unit for every set of two boys' hostels. Girls' hostel, however, has a separate mess of its own, situated within the boundary of the hostel. It is mandatory for the students staying in the hostel to have their food in the Hostel Messes. The messes attached to the hostels are fully managed by the students. A large number of scholarships, fellowships and other financial assistance are available to the students of the institute. Institute Merit and Merit-cum-Need Scholarships Students admitted to Integrated First Degree Programmes are eligible to receive these awards. The merit awards cover reimbursement of full semester fees and admission fees for top ten students of each batch, and 50% or 25% semester and admission fees for those selected for Merit-Cum-Need awards. In favor of the merit awards, students are automatically considered, and students desirous of being considered for the merit-cum-need awards need to apply each semester in response to the concerned notice. On an average, these awards benefit a little over 20% of the students. All awards are made for one semester only, and their continuance in the subsequent semester depends upon the candidate's performance in the institute. Student Aid Fund Some financial assistance may also be obtained from this fund. These awards are made normally in the second semester only. Students have to apply for this assistance in response to a notice. Other Scholarships & Aids Student Welfare Division also forwards applications from students for scholarship/ financial aid to external agencies. The Division, in case of special need, tries its best to help the students, by all possible means. AICTE Scholarship/Fellowship Schemes Students can Click to know about all the AICTE scholarship/fellowship schemes and their eligibility to apply. Student Welfare Division maintains the record of all student dues. While tuition and other fees are to be paid before the beginning of each semester, mess, electricity and other departmental dues are to be regularly paid from 15th to 25th of each month. Monthly dues are displayed on the SWD notice board as well as on the SWD website, and are intimated by e-mail. Payment of tuition and other fees, payable at registration time, is possible before registration day by Demand Drafts on United Commercial Bank (code- 0150), Vidya Vihar Branch, Pilani or State Bank of Bikaner & Jaipur (code-1398), Pilani. Cheques drawn on any of these two banks can be used to pay mess and other monthly dues. When dues are paid through cheques of local banks, the payment shall be valid subject to realization of the cheque. Withdrawal forms of UCO Bank, Vidya Vihar or State Bank of Bikaner & Jaipur, BITS Extn, can also be used for the payment purpose. Students, who fail to pay their dues by the announced dates, shall be required to pay at the time of next registration, an additional advance as per rules. Games and sports are organized through the Sports Club. The Institute has on its rolls Physical Director, Senior Coach, Life Saver (both male & female), Martial Art Instructor and other supporting staff. Facilities for the following games and sports are available: Football, Hockey, Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Tennis, Badminton, Table Tennis, Athletics, Gymnastics, Health Club, Swimming, Water Polo, Weight lifting etc.In addition to regular sports, special Yoga sessions (click here) are organized at Student Activity Center. Besides organizing routine activities in above-mentioned sports, the Sports Club also conducts the BITS Open Sports Meet (BOSM) in the First Semester every year in which several outstation teams participate. Health club is equipped with advanced exercising machines for weight training and aerobic exercise floor. A 25 x 12.5 m swimming pool provides facility for learning swimming, playing water polo and racing. Students can become members of Swimming Club/Health Club on payment of prescribed fees. Each hostel also has facility for volleyball, table tennis, badminton, chess, carom, etc. While the actual management of student activities is the responsibility of the Union & other bodies, the Division provides necessary support. The Students’ Union operates various clubs, including Music, Dance, Hindi Drama, English Drama, Hindi Press, English Press, Creative Activities, Mime, Photography, and Poetry Clubs, English Language Activities Society, and Hindi Activities Society. There are also several departments, which help organize various student events. Traditionally students organize OASIS, a cultural festival sometime during the days adjoining Dussehra or Diwali. The students also organize A Professions-Oriented Gathering over Educational Experience (APOGEE), an Academic Week during the Second Semester, which may be aptly described as the academic get-together of the University Youth. A classical music circle called 'Ragamalika' aims at encouraging budding talent among the students in music and dance. It also arranges performances by leading artists in the field of classical music and dance. In addition there is also a BITS Pilani Chapter of SPIC-MACAY, which organizes programmes to promote Indian classical music and culture amongst youth. BITS being an all-India Institute, there are also regional associations like Maurya Vihar, Sangam, Andhra Samiti, Tamil Mandram, Maharashtra Mandal, Moru Chhaya etc. conducting several special programmes on festivals. Recreational Activity Forum (RAF) that comes under the Student Welfare Division regularly organizes film shows for the BITS community. Currently, RAF organizes twelve, English and Hindi movies each, through the semester. Travel Concession The Railways, Airlines, and some nationalized Roadways permit students to travel on 'concessional' fares provided they produce Travel Concession orders issued by the Institute. The office of the Student Welfare Division issues such concession orders for various kinds of journeys by rail, which include, travelling to home town & back during semester breaks or summer vacations, travelling to places of practical training or to a Practice School Station, and travelling on behalf of the Institute as a representative. ID Card Every student upon admission is issued an Identity card by SWD at the beginning of every academic session with validity up to the end of that session. Incase of loss of ID card student should immediately inform to SWD office about the loss. Duplicate ID cards are issued on application along with the prescribed fees. Health and swimming club also require separate ID cards, than the normal ID cards issued to the student, every academic year. These ID cards are also provided to the students, seeking membership to the desired club, by SWD. Certificates/Attestations Student Welfare Division provides Bona fide, residence proof, CGPA conversion, expenditure, etc certificates, to the students, on request. Also, students can get their various documents attested, at or by help of SWD. Each hostel has Resident and Non-Resident Wardens drawn from the faculty. The resident student may approach the hostel warden for any advice or assistance. The students are advised to contact the Hostel Superintendents for any medical emergency. The contact details of the hostel staff are provided on the SWD page as well as on the notice board of each hostel. Please refer to the link for more details. A medical centre is located inside the campus. Please click here for more details. The Student Welfare Division (SWD) at BITS Pilani is committed to creating an inclusive and supportive environment for all students, including those with permanent and temporary disabilities. The division offers comprehensive disability & emotional support and personalized accommodations & services to ensure students facing challenges can fully participate in academic and campus life. Students who require disability support or any targeted assistance are encouraged to reach out to the Student Welfare Department. The process for seeking support is confidential, and the department is dedicated to providing students with a supportive and understanding environment.Every student is also assigned a Faculty Advisor/Mentor soon after admission from their respective department. The student should contact the mentor for any academic advice and other matters. For any issue related to mental health, the students may contact the Mpower centre located at the medical centre. For details about MPower, please click here. In addition to the MPower cell, the Institute arranges frequent visits of a counsellor for any issue related to mental health. The notification about the visit is sent through email to all.Students can also contact the Associate Dean Student Welfare Division for problems or advice directly. ©2026 Student Welfare Division (SWD), BITS Pilani-Pilani Campus Designed & Developed by IT Services Unit, BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus, India.

We the Student Welfare Division value originality and creativity backed up by planned and coherent team action. We are conscientious about virtually everything concerned with your stay here. To facilitate a pleasant environment, we take care of various aspects of student welfare like housing, financial aid & scholarships, health - care, games & sports maintenance of student dues, cultural activities and student counseling. The Institute is fully residential, and all students are provided hostel accommodation. Permission to become a day scholar may be granted only The Institute is fully residential, and all students are provided hostel accommodation. Permission to become a day scholar may be granted only under exceptional circumstances where the student's parents or relatives are Pilani residents. Facilities in the Hostels: There are eleven hostels for boys and one hostel complex for girls. The hostel rooms are fully furnished. Common room facilities with Cable TV and telephone are available in each hostel. Internet connectivity has been provided in all hostel rooms. Solar water heating systems are provided in all the hostels. More details can be found here. Hostel allotment: The allotment is done through a random process through an algorithm. The details are given here. For the specially-abled students, we provide accommodation on the hostel's ground floor on request to Chief Warden. Mess: There is a shared kitchen cum mess unit for every set of two boys' hostels. Girls' hostel, however, has a separate mess of its own, situated within the boundary of the hostel. It is mandatory for the students staying in the hostel to have their food in the Hostel Messes. The messes attached to the hostels are fully managed by the students. A large number of scholarships, fellowships and other financial assistance are available to the students of the institute. Institute Merit and Merit-cum-Need Scholarships Students admitted to Integrated First Degree Programmes are eligible to receive these awards. The merit awards cover reimbursement of full semester fees and admission fees for top ten students of each batch, and 50% or 25% semester and admission fees for those selected for Merit-Cum-Need awards. In favor of the merit awards, students are automatically considered, and students desirous of being considered for the merit-cum-need awards need to apply each semester in response to the concerned notice. On an average, these awards benefit a little over 20% of the students. All awards are made for one semester only, and their continuance in the subsequent semester depends upon the candidate's performance in the institute. Student Aid Fund Some financial assistance may also be obtained from this fund. These awards are made normally in the second semester only. Students have to apply for this assistance in response to a notice. Other Scholarships & Aids Student Welfare Division also forwards applications from students for scholarship/ financial aid to external agencies. The Division, in case of special need, tries its best to help the students, by all possible means. AICTE Scholarship/Fellowship Schemes Students can Click to know about all the AICTE scholarship/fellowship schemes and their eligibility to apply. Student Welfare Division maintains the record of all student dues. While tuition and other fees are to be paid before the beginning of each semester, mess, electricity and other departmental dues are to be regularly paid from 15th to 25th of each month. Monthly dues are displayed on the SWD notice board as well as on the SWD website, and are intimated by e-mail. Payment of tuition and other fees, payable at registration time, is possible before registration day by Demand Drafts on United Commercial Bank (code- 0150), Vidya Vihar Branch, Pilani or State Bank of Bikaner & Jaipur (code-1398), Pilani. Cheques drawn on any of these two banks can be used to pay mess and other monthly dues. When dues are paid through cheques of local banks, the payment shall be valid subject to realization of the cheque. Withdrawal forms of UCO Bank, Vidya Vihar or State Bank of Bikaner & Jaipur, BITS Extn, can also be used for the payment purpose. Students, who fail to pay their dues by the announced dates, shall be required to pay at the time of next registration, an additional advance as per rules. Games and sports are organized through the Sports Club. The Institute has on its rolls Physical Director, Senior Coach, Life Saver (both male & female), Martial Art Instructor and other supporting staff. Facilities for the following games and sports are available: Football, Hockey, Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Tennis, Badminton, Table Tennis, Athletics, Gymnastics, Health Club, Swimming, Water Polo, Weight lifting etc.In addition to regular sports, special Yoga sessions (click here) are organized at Student Activity Center. Besides organizing routine activities in above-mentioned sports, the Sports Club also conducts the BITS Open Sports Meet (BOSM) in the First Semester every year in which several outstation teams participate. Health club is equipped with advanced exercising machines for weight training and aerobic exercise floor. A 25 x 12.5 m swimming pool provides facility for learning swimming, playing water polo and racing. Students can become members of Swimming Club/Health Club on payment of prescribed fees. Each hostel also has facility for volleyball, table tennis, badminton, chess, carom, etc. While the actual management of student activities is the responsibility of the Union & other bodies, the Division provides necessary support. The Students’ Union operates various clubs, including Music, Dance, Hindi Drama, English Drama, Hindi Press, English Press, Creative Activities, Mime, Photography, and Poetry Clubs, English Language Activities Society, and Hindi Activities Society. There are also several departments, which help organize various student events. Traditionally students organize OASIS, a cultural festival sometime during the days adjoining Dussehra or Diwali. The students also organize A Professions-Oriented Gathering over Educational Experience (APOGEE), an Academic Week during the Second Semester, which may be aptly described as the academic get-together of the University Youth. A classical music circle called 'Ragamalika' aims at encouraging budding talent among the students in music and dance. It also arranges performances by leading artists in the field of classical music and dance. In addition there is also a BITS Pilani Chapter of SPIC-MACAY, which organizes programmes to promote Indian classical music and culture amongst youth. BITS being an all-India Institute, there are also regional associations like Maurya Vihar, Sangam, Andhra Samiti, Tamil Mandram, Maharashtra Mandal, Moru Chhaya etc. conducting several special programmes on festivals. Recreational Activity Forum (RAF) that comes under the Student Welfare Division regularly organizes film shows for the BITS community. Currently, RAF organizes twelve, English and Hindi movies each, through the semester. Travel Concession The Railways, Airlines, and some nationalized Roadways permit students to travel on 'concessional' fares provided they produce Travel Concession orders issued by the Institute. The office of the Student Welfare Division issues such concession orders for various kinds of journeys by rail, which include, travelling to home town & back during semester breaks or summer vacations, travelling to places of practical training or to a Practice School Station, and travelling on behalf of the Institute as a representative. ID Card Every student upon admission is issued an Identity card by SWD at the beginning of every academic session with validity up to the end of that session. Incase of loss of ID card student should immediately inform to SWD office about the loss. Duplicate ID cards are issued on application along with the prescribed fees. Health and swimming club also require separate ID cards, than the normal ID cards issued to the student, every academic year. These ID cards are also provided to the students, seeking membership to the desired club, by SWD. Certificates/Attestations Student Welfare Division provides Bona fide, residence proof, CGPA conversion, expenditure, etc certificates, to the students, on request. Also, students can get their various documents attested, at or by help of SWD. Each hostel has Resident and Non-Resident Wardens drawn from the faculty. The resident student may approach the hostel warden for any advice or assistance. The students are advised to contact the Hostel Superintendents for any medical emergency. The contact details of the hostel staff are provided on the SWD page as well as on the notice board of each hostel. Please refer to the link for more details. A medical centre is located inside the campus. Please click here for more details. The Student Welfare Division (SWD) at BITS Pilani is committed to creating an inclusive and supportive environment for all students, including those with permanent and temporary disabilities. The division offers comprehensive disability & emotional support and personalized accommodations & services to ensure students facing challenges can fully participate in academic and campus life. Students who require disability support or any targeted assistance are encouraged to reach out to the Student Welfare Department. The process for seeking support is confidential, and the department is dedicated to providing students with a supportive and understanding environment.Every student is also assigned a Faculty Advisor/Mentor soon after admission from their respective department. The student should contact the mentor for any academic advice and other matters. For any issue related to mental health, the students may contact the Mpower centre located at the medical centre. For details about MPower, please click here. In addition to the MPower cell, the Institute arranges frequent visits of a counsellor for any issue related to mental health. The notification about the visit is sent through email to all.Students can also contact the Associate Dean Student Welfare Division for problems or advice directly. ©2026 Student Welfare Division (SWD), BITS Pilani-Pilani Campus Designed & Developed by IT Services Unit, BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus, India.

BITS 2+2 International Collaborative Programmes' Admissions How the BITS 2+2 Program Works: BITS Pilani has partnered with five prestigious universities for its 4-year B.E. programs: RMIT University in Australia, the University at Buffalo in the USA, Iowa State University in the USA, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, USA and Centrale Superlac Paris, France. Through these 2+2 programs, students complete the first two years of their studies at BITS Pilani and the final two years at the respective partner university abroad, provided they meet the partner university's eligibility criteria. Upon graduation, students earn dual engineering degrees, one from BITS Pilani and one from the partner university. RMIT University, Australia BITS Pilani has partnered with RMIT University, Australia, to establish the BITS-RMIT Higher Education Academy. This academy offers 2+2 collaborative degree programs in five engineering disciplines: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics (EEE), Electronics and Communication (ECE), and Computer Science (CS). Click here for more information. University at Buffalo (UB), USA BITS Pilani has collaborated with the University at Buffalo, also known as The State University of New York, to offer students an exceptional opportunity to pursue unique 2+ 2 international academic programs in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), and Computer Science (CS). Click here for more information. Iowa State University, USA BITS Pilani has partnered with Iowa State University, Ames, to provide students with an exceptional opportunity to pursue unique 2+2 international collaborative academic programs in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), and Computer Science (CS). Click here for more information. Centrale Superlac Paris, France BITS Pilani has collaborated with the Centrale Superlac Paris, France, to offer students an exceptional opportunity to pursue unique 2+2 joint international academic programs in Computer Science. Click here for more information. Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI), USA BITS Pilani has partnered with Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, USA. This academy offers 2+2 joint collaborative degree programs in two engineering disciplines: Mechanical, and Electrical and Electronics. Click here for more information. Five-Year (3+2) Intercampus Degree Programme: B.E. with PCM input (in Pilani/Hyderabad/Goa Campuses) and MBA (BITSOM Campus) Meritorious and high-performing students enrolled in the B.E. programmes with PCM input at BITS Pilani STEM campuses of India will have the opportunity to pursue an inter-campus 3+2 degree programme, combining a B.E. degree at a BITS STEM campus in India with an MBA degree at BITSOM, Mumbai. BITSOM Campus, Mumbai The 3+2 Inter-campus Vertical Transfer Programme aims to nurture the next generation of technology-enabled business leaders by combining a rigorous engineering foundation with a top-tier management education. This unique offering integrates a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) programme from BITS Pilani (STEM campuses in India) with a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from programme BITSOM, Mumbai completed over a span of five years. Click here for FAQs. How to Join BITS Pilani's Higher Degree Programmes Admission to BITS Pilani's Higher Degree programmes is offered through three pathways. Through GATE Interested and eligible candidates can apply to all the Higher Degree Programmes (except M.E. Software Systems) based on GATE (for M.E.)/ GPAT (for M. Pharm.) score. Through BITSHD Test Interested and eligible candidates can apply to all the Higher Degree Programmes based on the marks obtained in the computer based BITS Higher Degree conducted by BITS. Both GATE and BITSHD Consideration for admission based on both GATE/GPAT scores and marks obtained in the BITS HD Test. Eligibility and Duration 1. Candidates need at least 60% marks in their qualifying B.E./B.Pharm degree exam. 2. Admission to all M.E. and M.Pharm programs is based on BITS HD test scores or valid GATE/GPAT scores. 3. Programs typically last four semesters. 4. For further details, read the brochure. Information on specific Departments and related research activities is available on the Department website of respective campuses. Candidates are requested to visit the relevant website and if needed, further contact the concerned Head of Department (HOD) for details. Full-time: Preferably individuals who would like to pursue Ph.D. in-house, residing on campus. Part-time: Preferably individuals working in organizations providing basic facilities and environment for research. Minimum Eligibility Qualifications: M.E./M.Tech./M.Pharm./MBA/M.Phil. or an equivalent Degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate in the qualifying examination. M.Sc./B.E./B.Pharm. or an equivalent degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate in the qualifying examination. For admissions to Humanities and Social Sciences, candidates with an M.A. degree and a minimum of 55% aggregate may apply. For part-time applicants, a minimum of one year experience in the related field of study is required. Note: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee admission into the PhD program. In addition, Departments may set specific admission criteria for shortlisting. Candidates are advised to visit the departmental website for specific admission criteria. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear for an admission test, which may comprise of a written exam and/or interview. Candidates admitted with qualifications including M.Sc., B.E., B.Pharm. etc., will be required to do course work with minimum of 6 courses and minimum 24 units in the first and second semester after admission to the programme. Candidates admitted with qualifications including M.E./M.Tech./M.Pharm./MBA/M.Phil. etc., will be required to do course work with minimum of 2 courses and minimum of 6 units in the Second Semester after admission to the programme. Financial Assistance All the full-time PhD students admitted into the PhD program will receive a fellowship up to a maximum of five years. The fellowship could be from the Institute or Sponsored Projects. PhD students may also have their own fellowship if qualified through UGC/CSIR NET. Students offered Institute fellowship will receive ₹37,000/- per month. The fellowship may be enhanced to ₹40,000/- or ₹42,000/- after two years based on the performance. Institute Fellows will also receive a contingency amount of ₹20,000/- per year. Students offered admission through Sponsored Projects would receive the fellowship in accordance with the funding agency guidelines. BITS Pilani provides one-time International Travel Support of up to ₹1.5 lakh to selected full-time Ph.D. students during their tenure, to present their work at an international conference.

BITSAT-2026 brochure A Computer Based Online Test for Admission to Integrated First Degree programmes of BITS Pilani for the Academic Year 2026-27 The Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS) Pilani, recognized as an Institution of Eminence by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is India's leading Institute of Higher Education and a Deemed to be University, with an illustrious legacy, modern campuses and eminent alumni in leadership positions across the world. The Institute's commitment to excellence, adherence to merit, transparency, innovation, and enterprise have characterized its steady march to eminence. It is the only Private University in India which DST, Government of India has identified to establish a Technology Innovation Hub under the BioCPS vertical with a grant of Rs 125 Crore. Admissions to all the Integrated First Degree (FD) programmes of BITS Pilani for its Campuses at Pilani, K K Birla Goa, and Hyderabad for the academic year 2026-27 will be made on the basis of a Computer based Online Test conducted by BITS Pilani. This test will be referred to as 'BITS Admission Test - 2026', in short as BITSAT-2026 hereafter in this document 1. Integrated FD programmes to which admissions will be made on the basis of BITSAT-2026: (i) at BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus: B.E.: Chemical, Civil, Computer Science, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Instrumentation, Electronics and Communication, Mathematics and Computing, Mechanical, Manufacturing Engg., Environmental and Sustainability Engg., Pharmaceutical Engg. B. Pharm. M.Sc.*: Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Semiconductor and Nanoscience M.Sc.: General Studies. (ii) at BITS Pilani, K K Birla Goa Campus: B.E.: : Chemical, Computer Science, Electronics and Communication, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Instrumentation, Electronics and Computer Engg., Mathematics and Computing, Mechanical, Environmental and Sustainability Engg. M.Sc.*: Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Semiconductor and Nanoscience. (iii) at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus: B.E.: : Chemical, Civil, Computer Science, Electronics and Communication, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Instrumentation, Mathematics and Computing, Mechanical, Environmental and Sustainability Engg., Pharmaceutical Engg. B. Pharm. M.Sc.*: Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Semiconductor and Nanoscience. * The candidates who join in M.Sc. programme are eligible to apply for dual degree in Engineering at BITS Pilani after completion of first year. This assignment is made by competition on their performance at BITS at the end of the first year. (For more details, refer to Admissions Modality available on the BITS admissions website: https://admissions.bits-pilani.ac.in/) Candidates appearing for the BITSAT-2026, based on their BITSAT score, will not only have the opportunity to apply for Admissions in First Degree (B.E. M.Sc., and B.Pharm.) Programmes offered for the entire duration of the programmes exclusively by the Indian Campuses of BITS Pilani but also will have the opportunity to apply for a few selected 2+2 Joint Collaborative Programmes offered by BITS Pilani and a few reputed International Universities in Australia and USA (e.g., RMIT University, Melbourne; Iowa State University, Ames, USA; University at Buffalo, New York, USA; Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, New York, USA; Centrale Superlac Paris, France). These 2+2 Joint-Collaborative Programmes initiatives will allow students to spend their initial two years at the BITS Pilani campus in India, benefiting from cutting-edge facilities and esteemed faculty resources of BITS Pilani. Subsequently, students admitted under Joint-Collaborative Programmes will spend the remaining two years at their chosen foreign university, providing access to a world-class international education. More details about the Joint-Collaborative Programmes initiatives shall be available on the website in due course of time.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA (i) B.E. (Except B.E. Environmental and Sustainability Engg.), and M.Sc. Programmes: 1. Candidates must have completed their 12th-grade examination under the 10+2 system from a recognized Central or State board or an equivalent qualification. 2. A minimum of five subjects is required, including Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, one Language, and any additional subject beyond these four. 3. Candidates must secure: 3.1. An aggregate of 75% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, and 3.2. At least 60% marks in each of Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics individually. 4. Both theory and practical components must be considered while calculating percentages. (ii) B.Pharm., and B.E. Environmental and Sustainability Engg. Programme * 1. Candidates must have completed their 12th-grade examination under the 10+2 system from a recognized Central or State board or an equivalent qualification. 2. A minimum of five subjects is required, including Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Mathematics, one Language, and any additional subject beyond these four. 3. Candidates must secure: 3.1. An aggregate of 75% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics, and 3.2. At least 60% marks in each of Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics individually. 4. Both theory and practical components must be considered while calculating percentages. * Students entering through the PCB stream at the 10+2 level should possess mathematics proficiency at the high school (Class 10) level. Admissions to all the programmes are subject to the conditions given below: Students who are appearing for the 12th examination in 2026 or who have passed the 12th Examination in 2025 are eligible to appear in the BITSAT-2026. If a candidate has taken more than one attempt in the 12th class or its equivalent, only his/her latest performance is considered. Additionally, the candidates must meet the following conditions: a). Students must appear for their 12th-grade examination for the first time in 2025 or 2026 in a board, with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology as compulsory subjects, provided their results are available by the submission deadline (June 01, 2026), as specified on the admissions portal. OR b). Students who completed their 12th-grade examination in 2025 may reappear for improvement exams in specific subject(s). The results of these improvements must be available by the submission deadline (June 01, 2026), as specified on the admissions portal. OR In all the above cases, the candidates' "Pass" status must remain unchanged after taking the improvement exam or repeating Grade 12.

Scholarships (Based on BITSAT-2026 score*) Scholarship policy for First Degree students admitted through BITSAT-2026 A large number of scholarships, fellowships and other financial assistance are available to the students of the Institute such as Institute's own merit or merit-cum-need awards for students. About 25% of the students receive some form of financial assistance or other even before admissions. For continuance of scholarships, scholarship holders are required to maintain good scholastic standing and good conduct. Tuition-blind admissions for Top 500 BITSAT rankers (AY 2026-27 onwards): Starting in AY 2026-27, BITS Pilani will take a landmark step in its 60-year journey by introducing tuition-blind admissions for the top 500 BITSAT rankers. Eligible candidates with an annual family income of up to ₹20 lakh will receive a full tuition scholarship for all four years, subject to maintaining a minimum CGPA of 7.5 at their respective campuses. This is not a scholarship students must apply for after joining; rather, it is an assurance built into the admission offer, ensuring that top performers can choose BITS based on aspiration and opportunity, not affordability. This initiative is enabled by growing alumni support and sustained institutional investment. Over the coming years, BITS intends to expand this coverage progressively, with the long-term goal of moving towards tuition blind admissions for all. Institute's own merit or merit-cum-need awards for students: a) For FD students: Every year about 25% of students admitted to First Degree Programmes get semester tuition fee waivers in the range between 10% to 100% in the form of either merit or merit-cum need scholarships as tabulated below: Under Institute's own merit award scheme Amount of scholarship Top 2% Students 100% of total tuition fee The next top 1% Students 50% of total tuition fee Under Institute's own merit-cum-need awards scheme Amount of scholarship Top 5% Students 100% of total tuition fee The next top 2% Students 50% of total tuition fee The next top 5% Students 25% of total tuition fee The next 10% Students 10% of total tuition fee b) All awards are made for one semester only and their continuance in the subsequent semesters(s) will depend on the candidate's performance in the Institute and his/her needs. c) The above are for a normal situation. Wherever a student's programme gets modified or his progress is delayed beyond the maximum permissible, such a student is advised to consult the appropriate authority before registration. d) The fees and other charges are payable in advance in each semester/term on the notified dates before registration. No withdrawal from a course or courses will entitle a student for refund of fees. Scholarship policy for First Degree students admitted through 2+2 Dual Degree programmes with foreign Universities The above both scholarships are also available to the Students admitted to the 2+2 Dual Degree programmes with foreign Universities only for the first two years depending on their overall performance in BITSAT (at the time of admission for First Semester) among all students admitted through BITSAT in all the schemes and overall performance among all students at their respective Campuses in the subsequent semesters admitted through BITSAT in all the schemes in their batch. However, the percentage of tuition fee waiver for the Students admitted to the 2+2 Dual Degree programs with foreign Universities should be capped at the same level as the fee waiver granted to the students admitted to the regular 4-/5-year programmes at the Pilani, Goa and Hyderabad campuses. Further, the remaining two years, such students may avail the scholarships benefits provided by the respective foreign Universities as per their eligibility criteria mentioned in the respective admission brochure of the university (BITS-RMIT Higher Education Academy, BITS-UB (UBITS) 2+2 International Collaborative Programmes, BITS-ISU 2+2 International Collaborative Programmes, BITS- CSP 2+2 International Collaborative Programmes, BITS-RPI 2+2 International Collaborative Programme). Note: There will be no waiver of the admission fee.

Schedule of Fees for the academic year 2026-27First Degree programmes( B.E., M.Sc., B.Pharm.) The following is the details of the fees for the Academic Year 2026-27 at different Campuses of BITS Pilani. Fees Pilani Campus Goa Campus Hyderabad Campus Admission Fees 64,100/- 64,100/- 64,100/- Semester/Term Fees First Semester Second Semester Summer term (if Registered) 2,91,500/- 2,91,500/- 102,000/- 2,91,500/- 2,91,500/- 102,000/- 2,91,500/- 2,91,500/- 102,000/- Student's Union fee (Annual) 450/- 450/- 450/- Student's Aid Fund (Annual) 225/- 225/- 225/- Hostel fee (for on-campus students only) First Semester Second Semester Summer term (if Registered) 36,000/- 36,000/- 18,000/- 36,000/- 36,000/- 18,000/- 36,000/- 36,000/- 18,000/- Mess & Electricity advance First Semester Second Semester Summer term (if Registered) (Payable at the beginning of each semester/term and adjustable at the end of the same) 10,000/- 10,000/- 5,000/- 10,000/- 10,000/- 5,000/- 10,000/- 10,000/- 5,000/- Other Advances First Semester Second Semester (Payable at the beginning of each semester/term and adjustable at the end of the same) 12,000/- 12,000/- 12,000/- 12,000/- 12,000/- 12,000/- Institute Caution Deposit 3,000/- 3,000/- 3,000/- Notes: (Applicable to Pilani, K K Birla Goa, and Hyderabad Campus candidates) 1. The above prescribed semester fees is for the Integrated First Degree students admitted in the academic year 2026-27. For these students, the Semester Tuition, Summer Term and Hostel fees will be revised upward every year. The details of semester tuition fee and summer term fee is given below (unless the government announces any new levy/tax, which will be passed on to all existing students irrespective of their year of entry). Tuition fees per semester & summer term fee (if it is required to register in summer) for the students admitted in academic year 2026-27 [for Domestic students] (Amount in INR) Academic Year of admission AY 2026-27 AY 2027-28 AY 2028-29 AY 2029-30 AY 2030-31 Semester Tuition Fee 2,91,500/- 3,06,000/- 3,21,500/- 3,37,500/- 3,54,500/- Summer Term Fee 1,02,000/- 1,07,100/- 1,12,500/- 1,18,100/- 1,24,100/- 2. Summer Term Tuition Fee will be 35% of Semester Tuition Fee in corresponding Academic Year. All three Indian campuses will have the same summer term fee in an academic year. It is to be noted that every summer term is not part of the academic calendar except where specifically stated. Though the prescribed summer term fee for domestic students is mentioned above, depending on the requirement of registration of a student in a given summer term, he/she will be required to pay summer term fee for that particular academic year only. 3. If a student is admitted to a second degree programme under dual degree scheme, the candidate has to pay admission fees of the second programme at the time such admission is made. 4. If a single degree student registers for PS II in a Semester, such candidate has to pay the semester fees of the batch for that semester plus additional fees of summer term of previous academic year because the practice school is longer than a semester and extends it to summer (i.e. about 35% of the Semester fees of the previous Academic Year). 5. All fees are to be paid in advance. Only caution deposit and mess advance are refundable after adjustment of dues at the time of graduation or withdrawal from the Institute. This applies to prospective candidates who are seeking admission as well as ongoing students of the Institute. 6. If any continuing student is also admitted to a minor programme, he/she has to pay a fee of Rs. 34,000/- for AY 2026-27 in addition to fees for the semesters / summer terms enrolled in. The fee is payable in two installments - Rs. 17,000/- at the time of admission as minor application fee and Rs. 17,000/- on completion of requirements as minor certificate fee. Admission fees for minor programme will be revised in subsequent years as per Institute norms. 7. If there are dues outstanding from a student, his grades will be withheld. 8. Students who accumulate mess arrears would be required to pay a prescribed additional advance at the time of next registration. 9. For some specific programmes requiring special treatment, fees and mode of their payment will be determined by the Vice-Chancellor in consultation with the Chancellor.

FAQs BITSAT-2026 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Responses What is the BITS Admissions Website? https://admissions.bits-pilani.ac.in/ Where I can find the syllabus of BITSAT? The BITSAT syllabus is mentioned in the brochure available at BITS admissions website (https://admissions.bits-pilani.ac.in/) I want some model question paper of BITSAT or the questions of previous years. BITS do not provide any model question paper. The BITSAT syllabus is mentioned in the brochure available at BITS admissions website (https://admissions.bits-pilani.ac.in/) What was the cut-off score for Computer Science Programme in earlier years? The cut-off scores of the last few years for all the programmes at BITS campuses are available at our admission website. I am willing to take admission in any of the three BITS campuses. Do I need to apply online separately for all campuses? No, you need not to apply separately for any of the three campuses. What is the Eligibility Criteria to take the undergraduate admission in BITS? The candidate should have minimum 75% or more in PCM/PCB in aggregate and minimum 60% or more in individual subjects (PCM/PCB) in 12th class. PCM means only the marks obtained in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. PCB means only the marks obtained in Physics, Chemistry and Biology. PCB candidates are eligible to apply only for 'B.Pharmacy' and 'B.E. Environmental and Sustainability Enggineering' Programme. I have 74.90% aggregate in PCM. The round-off percentage is 75%. Am I eligible to apply for admission? No. The candidate should have minimum 75% or more in PCM/PCB in aggregate and minimum 60% or more in individual subjects (PCM/PCB) in 12th class. I have taken Physics, Chemistry and Biology in 10+2. Am I eligible to apply for BITSAT? Candidates can write BITSAT exam with Physics, Chemistry and Biology in 10+2. However, they will be eligible to apply only for the 'B.Pharmacy' and 'B.E. Environmental and Sustainability Enggineering' program. They will not be eligible for any other first-degree programme of the Institute. I have taken Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in 10+2. Am I eligible to apply for B.Pharm. Programme? Yes, you are eligible to apply for B.Pharm. and any other First Degree programme of the institute. My 12th exam results are not expected before 01st June 2026. Should I apply for BITSAT? For admissions to First Degree Programme 2026-27 starting in July/August, you should have your result before June month. Keeping that in mind, you may appear in BITSAT exam. I passed 12th exam in 2025. Am I eligible to appear for BITSAT-2026? As advertised, you are eligible to apply for BITSAT-2026. I passed 12th exam in 2024. Am I eligible to apply for BITSAT-2026? No. The candidate who passed his/her 12th board examination in 2025 and passing out in 2026 are only eligible to apply for BITSAT-2026. To appear in BITSAT, the students who passed or who appeared their 12th class in the current academic year and who passed their 12th class in the previous academic year are only eligible. How am I eligible for admission to M.Sc. programmes after 12th? The M.Sc. programmes are 4-year Integrated First Degree programmes after 12th. There is no intermediate B.Sc. degree awarded. I had appeared in BITSAT-2025 but my marks were below the cut-off marks. Can I appear in BITSAT-2026? Yes, as advertised, subject to eligibility conditions you can apply again for BITSAT-2026. I have passed 12th in the year 2024 (or earlier). I am now doing my higher studies (B.Sc./B.E./Diploma) in another college. Can I apply for BITSAT-2026? You are NOT eligible to appear in BITSAT-2026. I am unable to access the online application. Can you send the application form by email or post? The application cannot be sent by email/post. If you get any specific error while applying, please send an email to bitsat@pilani.bits-pilani.ac.in for help with details and queries will also be answered by the admission office available at the numbers +91 1596 255294, 255330, 255540, 255541. I have completed the online application. But, I have not taken a printout. How can I get a printout now? You can go to the Online Application Page again and enter the login credentials. You will be taken to the printout page again. I forgot my application number. How can I get it now? After the registration, you receive an email/SMS to your registered email id/mobile number with the application number. By mistake the email of my application number got deleted. How can I retrieve my application number? In case you have missed the email then you can send an email requesting for application number to the above mentioned email id. The mail should be sent from your registered email id only. I have made multiple payments for single application because of connection error. How will I get back my extra amount? If you have made multiple payments towards BITSAT application fee for an application, Institute will refund the extra amount. You have to provide your bank details to claim this amount through the online link. The link will be provided to your registered email id. I have made a mistake while entering some data in my application form. How can I edit/correct it? The link for editing the application form will be made available on the website. Please refer to the link for important dates: on our admission website. You can make changes in your application form except Gender, Contact No. and E-mail id. No email queries/request will be entertained in this regard. I have applied for both the sessions of BITSAT-2026. I could not attend the Session-1 of BITSAT-2026, will I be eligible to attend the Session-2? Yes. If you have applied for BOTH the sessions, you are eligible to attend the Session-2 of BITSAT-2026. Your score of Session-2 will be considered for the admission process. I have only applied for Session-1 of BITSAT-2026. I could not attend the session-1. Am I eligible to apply for Session-2 during the application window mentioned in the brochure? Yes. You are eligible to apply for the Session-2 during the application window. Please refer to the link for important dates: on our admission website I did not apply for BITSAT-2026 Session-1. Am I eligible to apply for Session-2 during the application window mentioned in the brochure? Yes. You are eligible to apply for Session-2 during the Session-2 application window. Please refer to the link for important dates: on our admission website. I have attempted both the Sessions of BITSAT-2026? How my score will be considered for the admission? For a candidate who has appeared twice in BITSAT-2026, and then seeks admission to any of the First Degree programmes in BITS Pilani, the higher of the two scores will be considered for admission. I want to attend both the sessions of BITSAT-2026, but I missed to choose that 'BOTH' option and I have already made the application fee payment? If you have completed your application by making the payment, then you cannot select 'BOTH' option now. You will be able to apply for Session-2 during the application window which will be made available on the admission website. Please note that you will be charged application fee for the same. Please refer to the link for important dates: on our admission website. I will not be able to attend Session-1 of BITSAT-2026 in the month of April, hence I want to apply for Session-2. There is no option of selecting only Session-2 in the online application form? There is no option for selecting ONLY Session-2 of BITSAT-2026. However, as per the timelines mentioned in the brochure the link to apply for Session-2 will be available at the admission website (click here). What are the tuition and other fees and expenses? Fee structure details are available at our website. Click here for fee details. Are there any admissions for lateral position? No. BITS do not have lateral entry admissions. Is there any Management Seat? No. BITS Pilani do not offer admissions on the basis of management quota. Do you have any reservation for admissions? No. BITS Pilani do not have any kind of reservations. What is a Dual Degree? How is it assigned to a particular student and when? BITS Pilani has created provisions by which, any student who is admitted to a particular M.Sc. program (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Economics, Semiconductor and Nanoscience), is accommodated in a dual degree scheme, with a second degree in available B.E. programs. The assignment of the second degree in B.E. for the M.Sc. students is announced generally at the completion of their first year courses. The allotment process to a particular B.E. stream, is purely on the basis of the academic performances of the students in the 1st year at BITS and the number of seats available in that particular programme. If a student is admitted to a second degree programme under dual degree scheme, he/she has to pay the admission fees of the second programme, separately, at the time of such admission is made. The curriculum for such dual degree students are designed in such a way, that the students will complete all the formalities required for both the degrees,normally in five years. Are the students admitted in B.Pharm. with PCM and/or PCB input, also eligible to apply for the dual degree? There will be restrictions on the availability of flexibility such as transfer and dual degree allotment for students admitted to B. Pharm. programme with PCB input. Since all the first degree programmes other than B. Pharm. programme requires PCM input, no transfer/dual degree allotment is possible with PCB input. Is there any 2-year M.Sc. Program at BITS Pilani? No. There is no 2 year M.Sc. Program offered at BITS Pilani, currently. How a candidate is eligible to take admission to M.Sc. Programmes in BITS after their 12th class, without B.Sc.? The M.Sc. programmes are 4-year integrated programmes after 12th class, covering the curriculum required for both B.Sc and M.Sc. There is no intermediate B.Sc. degree awarded. I have completed my 12th Class with PCB. Can I apply for M.Sc. Biology as the first degree programme or PCM input is mandatory? PCM input is mandatory. The students who are admitted in M.Sc. courses will be given a provision to take the admission in another B.E. course at the end of the 1st year, known as dual degree, which requires Mathematics as one of the subjects in their 12th Class. I have completed 12th class from NIOS board. Am I eligible to take the admission in BITS? Yes, if you have appeared in all the components of 12th Board Examination of NIOS you are eligible to apply for admissions to BITS Pilani. BITS Pilani consider the JEE Mains score for admissions? No, BITS Pilani do not consider the JEE Mains score for admission. Its admissions are based on the BITSAT score. What is the application procedure for NRIs? There is no separate procedure for NRIs. However, those candidates who have citizenship other than INDIA can apply under International Students Admissions Scheme. For more details Click Here What is the application procedure for candidates with foreign qualifications? There is no separate procedure for those candidates who wish to be admitted through BITSAT. They have to apply similar to Indian students and to provide an equivalence certificate from AIU at the time of applying for Admissions later. I am NRI student, am I eligible to apply through BITS ISA window? The candidate who wants to apply through BITS ISA window should be holding a passport and citizenship of the country, other than India. For more details Click Here What is the eligibility criteria for the admission under 'Direct Admission to Board Topper Scheme'? This offer of admission is open only to the student(s) who has/have obtained the first rank in a State or central Board, as per the announcement by the concerned State or Central Board. Presently I am studying in one of the BITS campuses, am I eligible to apply for BITSAT-2026? No. The students who are presently studying in BITS at any of its campuses are not eligible to apply for BITSAT-2026. Where can my parents stay near to BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus? The list of nearby hotels is given on the following link. Click here Where can my parents stay near to BITS Pilani, K K Birla Goa Campus? The list of nearby hotels is given on the following link. Click here Where can my parents stay near to BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus? The list of nearby hotels is given on the following link. Click here Where I can find the BITSAT Application form to download? The BITSAT online application form is available at https://admissions.bits-pilani.ac.in/. The application form cannot be sent by email/post. I have chosen the wrong center in my application? How can I change it? The center can be changed/edited during the edit window which will be made available on admission website. Please refer to the link for important dates: on our admission website. I want to change the center for Session-2 only. How can I change it? The center can be changed during the application window of Session-2. It will be made available on the admission website. Please refer to the link for important dates: on our admission website. I will not be able to attend Session-1 of BITSAT-2026 in the month of May, hence I want to apply for Session-2. There is no option of selecting only Session-2 in the online application form? There is no option for selecting ONLY Session-2 of BITSAT-2026 now. However, as per the timelines mentioned in the brochure and at BITS admission website; the link to apply for Session-2 will be available at the admission website at https://admissions.bits-pilani.ac.in. I want to change my test date and slot for Session-1 or Session-2. How can I change that? There is no edit/change option in submitted test date and slot, hence you need to be very careful while selecting the date and slot. What is the admission process/eligibility criteria for Dubai Campus, as details regarding the same are not mentioned on the BITSAT-2026 brochure? Please refer to the www.bits-dubai.ac.ae for details regarding the admission for BITS Pilani, Dubai Campus. I appeared for the 12th Board examination for the first time in 2025, but I reappeared for all subjects in 2026. What 12th year of passing should I fill in BITSAT-2026? Since you reappeared for all the subjects in 2026, your year of passing the 12th exam will be 2026. Please note that your latest marks will be considered. I appeared for the 12th Board examination for the first time in 2025, but I did not reappear in all the subjects for improvement. I appeared only in the 'n' number of subject(s) in 2026. What 12th year of passing should I fill in BITSAT-2026? Since you appeared only in a few subjects for improvement in 2026, your year of passing the 12th exam will be 2025. You will provide both of your marks sheets, the first Marks of the statement along with the improved marks of the statement. Please note that your latest marks will be considered. My daughter is OCI and has a US passport. She has been studying since 1st grade in India and is studying in 12th class from Telangana State Board. Is she eligible to write BITSAT or has to only go through ISA? The OCI card holders can apply through both the admission modes BITSAT and International Student Admission (ISA) Mode. I am a foreign national. What fees do I need to pay if I get admitted based on my BITSAT Score? If a foreign national gets admission based on the BITSAT score, the candidate will pay the fees as mentioned in the schedule of fees at fee page. I am an OCI card Holder. What Nationality should I fill in the BITSAT Application Form? You need to enter your nationality as per your passport. I am an OCI Card Holder and hold a foreign passport. What fees do I need to pay if I get admitted based on my BITSAT Score? If a foreign national gets admission based on the BITSAT score, the candidate will pay the fees as mentioned in the schedule of fees on the fees page. I have applied for the Improvement Exams in all the subjects but I want to reappear only in a few subjects. Am I eligible for admission to BITS, if I do not re-appear in all the subjects and go for improvement exams only in a few subjects? Yes, you can apply for admission if you remain absent in a few subjects. In this case, you will be required to submit your first marks sheet and the latest improvement mark sheet. Why am I being redirected to a different website to complete my application? BITS Pilani uses a secure, official application platform hosted on cdn3.digialm.com for processes such as ISA applications and BITSAT registration. This platform is managed in collaboration with our technology partner to ensure scalability, reliability, and a smooth application experience. After giving the BITSAT exam, I have to apply for admission by filling up the Preference Form in which I primarily (among other details) give my preferences of programmes and Class 12 marks. The deadline for applying is June 01, 2026. What if my board has not declared the Class 12 result by this date? Candidates whose respective board has not declared the Class 12 result by June 01, 2026 are still required to complete and submit the FD Preference Form, including programme preferences and applicable fee payment, between April 21 and June 01, 2026, to be considered for the admission process. However, such candidates will be permitted to submit their Class 12 marks and upload the corresponding marksheet/certificate on or before July 10, 2026, once the results are declared. Please note that if, at any stage of the admission process, it is found that a candidate does not fulfill the prescribed eligibility criteria, the candidature will be cancelled, irrespective of the stage at which this is discovered.

BITS Pilani (an Institution of Eminence in India) has entered a partnership with RMIT University, Australia, to develop a Higher Education Academy called BITS-RMIT Higher Education Academy. The BITS-RMIT Academy offers collaborative degree programmes at the international level. Students admitted under this collaboration will have the unique opportunity to immerse themselves in diverse cultures and gain a truly global perspective. About BITS Pilani BITS Pilani is a Deemed to be University, offering on-campus programs to 18,500+ students across its campuses in Pilani, Goa, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Dubai. In 2020, it was conferred the status of an Institution of Eminence by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Department of Management at BITS Pilani was established in 1971. It initially offered two years' Master of Business Administration (MBA). In 1973, MBA evolved into the integrated first-degree program MMS (Master of Management Studies) which was a unique blend of engineering and management. The objective of this program was to bridge the gap in the industry by providing quality management professionals with strong technical skills and acumen for managing a business. Based on demands from the industry, the course was restructured again as an MBA in 2006. Catering to contemporary industry demands, BITS Pilani introduced an MBA in Business Analytics in 2021-22. Over the years, BITS Pilani has laid considerable stress on the importance of experience as a part of the education process, by ensuring that its programs interface strongly with industry, and provide for opportunities for students to engage in independent experiential learning. The MBA in Business Analytics curriculum is an optimum combination of core, electives and industrial component / research in the form of Practice School / dissertation. The pedagogy ensures that at least 50% of the sessions are devoted to cases / projects / simulations / laboratories / other experiential components. BITS Pilani is in the 451-500 band globally in Business and Management Studies by QS World University Rankings by Subject (2025) Highlights of the MBA in Business Analytics Programme: Management education at BITS Pilani brings cutting-edge thinking and best learning practices with MBA in Business Analytics. Three semesters of rigorous on-campus training coupled with an option of either six months' exposure to industry through a structured and evaluative paid internship (Practice School) or dissertation makes this programme unique. In Practice School, students work on real-time projects in reputed companies with the possibility of getting a pre placement offer on its completion. Hands-on laboratory sessions and innovative teaching pedagogies to aid classroom teaching Certification programs / training workshops will be organized for improving necessary skills related to business analytics Continuous interaction with leading experts from the industry Possibility of international immersion Legendary alumni network of BITS Pilani for mentorship Substantial financial assistance through teaching assistantship Eligibility for admission: Candidates holding a bachelor's degree of minimum three years duration in any discipline or its equivalent with at least 60% aggregate marks, and having studied at least one subject in mathematics or statistics at the high school (10+2) or higher level. Candidates with prior exposure to a programming language are desirable. Students who are in the final year of their Qualifying Degree programme are also eligible to apply, provided they can submit the original copies of the results till 1st October, 2026, and fulfil other criteria. Application Procedure: The link to apply for admission to the Two-Year On-Campus MBA in Business Analytics BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus is available at our admission website. Online application will close at 11:59 PM on February 16, 2026 (extended deadline). The application fee is INR 3300/-, mode of payment is online and has been provided at the online application link. The application fee is non-refundable and not-transferable. Test Centers: BAAT is proposed to be conducted in Assam (Guwahati), Andhra Pradsh (Vizag), Bihar (Patna), Chandigarh (Chandigarh), Gujarat (Ahmedabad), Goa (Goa), Kerala (Thiruvanthapuram), Karnataka (Bengaluru), Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal), Maharashtra (Mumbai, Nagpur, Pune), New Delhi (New Delhi), Odisha (Bhubaneswar), Rajasthan (Jaipur), Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Coimbatore), Telangana (Hyderabad), Uttarakhand (Dehradun), Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow), and West Bengal (Kolkata).

Hands-on laboratory sessions and innovative teaching pedagogies to aid classroom teaching Certification programs / training workshops will be organized for improving necessary skills related to business analytics Continuous interaction with leading experts from the industry Possibility of international immersion Legendary alumni network of BITS Pilani for mentorship Substantial financial assistance through teaching assistantship Eligibility for admission: Candidates holding a bachelor's degree of minimum three years duration in any discipline or its equivalent with at least 60% aggregate marks, and having studied at least one subject in mathematics or statistics at the high school (10+2) or higher level. Candidates with prior exposure to a programming language are desirable. Students who are in the final year of their Qualifying Degree programme are also eligible to apply, provided they can submit the original copies of the results till 1st October, 2026, and fulfil other criteria. Application Procedure: The link to apply for admission to the Two-Year On-Campus MBA in Business Analytics BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus is available at our admission website. Online application will close at 11:59 PM on February 16, 2026 (extended deadline). The application fee is INR 3300/-, mode of payment is online and has been provided at the online application link. The application fee is non-refundable and not-transferable. Test Centers: BAAT is proposed to be conducted in Assam (Guwahati), Andhra Pradsh (Vizag), Bihar (Patna), Chandigarh (Chandigarh), Gujarat (Ahmedabad), Goa (Goa), Kerala (Thiruvanthapuram), Karnataka (Bengaluru), Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal), Maharashtra (Mumbai, Nagpur, Pune), New Delhi (New Delhi), Odisha (Bhubaneswar), Rajasthan (Jaipur), Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Coimbatore), Telangana (Hyderabad), Uttarakhand (Dehradun), Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow), and West Bengal (Kolkata).

BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY & SCIENCE, PILANI STUDENT WELFARE DIVISION No. SWD/SCH/73 Dated: 09th March, 2022 NOTICE Institute Merit-Cum-Need Scholarships, Second Semester, 2021-2022 All first degree students should note the following procedure for applying for the Institute Merit- cum-Need Scholarships for Second Semester 2021-2022. 1. The award of scholarships will be decided at the end of Second Semester and will be based on the performance of students in the Second Semester. 2. The types of scholarships are as follows: i.) Merit Scholarships: These will cover 100% reimbursement of semester fees for 1% students and 40% of semester fees for 2% students. ii.) Merit-cum-Need Scholarships: These will cover 80% reimbursement of semester fees for 3% students; 40% of semester fees for 6% students; 25% of semester fees for 12% students and 15% of semester fees for 6% students. Minimum CGPA 6.00 is required for award of scholarships. 3. There is no waiver of admission fee. 4. No application is necessary for Merit Scholarships. 5. The application should be submitted on-line on or before 1.00 p.m. Saturday, 30th April 2022, through SWD website link (http://swd.bits-pilani.ac.in). This will be accessible from 09th March 2022. 6. Latest income certificate(s) should be submitted before the deadline along with the details of the applicant on a cover sheet available at SWD office (Room No. 2102-E). Students who have already submitted Valid Income Certificate(s) during First Semester 2021-2022 need not submit one again. DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED The following documents for the FINANCIAL YEAR 2020-21 (ASSESSMENT YEAR 2021-22) should be submitted:- If parents/guardians are: Salaried/Engaged in Business/Pensioner – a) If parent(s)/guardian are salaried persons/Business, Copy of ITR along with Computation of income stamped by IT department clearly showing the gross total income can be submitted (copy of E-Filing of returns is also valid). b) If Engaged in Agriculture only – Original Income Certificate from Mandal Revenue Officer gross income for the financial year 2020-2021 (ASSESSMENT YEAR 2021-22) based on the income of the preceding financial year along with parents bank statement for past six months. In case of any educational loan, a copy of loan sanction letter to be submitted. c) Pensioners shall submit the Retirement letter along with the bank statement showing the pension credited. In case of any educational loan, a copy of loan sanction letter to be submitted. Continued… -- 1 of 2 -- NOTE 1) AFFIDAVITS are directly rejected. 2) Mere income statements and declarations by parents/their employers, notary affidavit, certificate from bank, annual pension statements etc will not be accepted. 3) Income certificates of BOTH parents must be provided in case both are earning persons. 4) All the income statements should be for the Financial Year 2020-21 (Assessment Year 2021-22) dated after 1st April 2021. 5) Income statements of earlier years will be directly rejected. THE ELIGIBILTY CRITERIA FOR AWARD OF SCHOLARSHIP a) Scholarships are awarded to the student(s) for the normal course duration. Normal course duration for Single Degree is four years and for Dual Degree is five years. b) The scholarships are awarded to students based on CGPA and gross annual income of parent(s)/guardian from all sources should be less than the maximum prescribed by the Scholarships Committee. Prescribed maximum limit for the previous semester was Rs. 11,00,000/- p.a. c) No NC/E/RC report in the second semester. d) No case of indiscipline in the second semester. e) Not availing any external scholarship that carries a condition that the student is not receiving any other scholarship. Students are to certify that they are not availing any other scholarship such as Inspire/KVPY etc. Any student availing fee benefit scheme is not eligible. f) In case of any ambiguity, certificates in original should be produced by the student on demand. g) Any discrepancies in the Parents details provided when compared with the previous semester the application will be directly rejected without any intimation. h) Both the Parents/guardians gross total income should be clearly mentioned. i) The application for MCN should be filled in very clearly and no changes will be encouraged later. j) All the applications, documents and certificates will be scrutinized by the authorities. It is the responsibility of all the students to check notices and SWD Portal or contact the SWD office for details of the MCN Scholarship. All decisions of the Scholarships Committee are final and binding. (Prof. Srikanta Routroy) All Notice Boards Associate Dean -- 2 of 2 --

Though we have not many banks amongst us, it does not follow that we are not capable of efficiently managing crores and tens of crores of rupees." HOSTEL ALLOTMENT GUIDELINES ● Portal will be open for F2018/F2019/F2020/F2021/F2022 batches only, on 20/07/2023 (11:00 AM). The portal will be closed on 23/07/2023 (11:00 PM). ● No further queries/e-mails will be entertained for Hostel Allocation. Please make judicious use of the flexibility given. ● For any query, please mail at campusopening@pilani.bits-pilani.ac.in, f20210923@pilani.bits-pilani.ac.in or fill the query form on the website. Only the sensible queries will be answered. General Instructions: 1. Only students who have opted for hostel allocation will be allowed to form wings. 2. If a student (eg. Dayscholar ) wishes to opt out Hostel Allocation, they may do so by selecting the opt out of hostel allocation option on the portal. 3. Students who have opted out of Hostel Allocation will not be allotted rooms under any circumstances. Use this option with discretion. 4. Students who wish to sit for random allocation don't need to do anything. They would be automatically considered for random allocation. 5. Wing Representatives should fill Hostel Preferences on the portal. 6. After wing allotment, wing representatives will be allowed to allot rooms inside the allocated wing. 7. Students who are currently on their PS-2/off-campus thesis will be allotted rooms separately next semester. Please note that: ➢ Allotment will NOT be done on a First come First serve basis. It is done through a random process through an algorithm. ➢ Maximum Wing Size: 12 ➢ No Minimum Wing Size. ➢ Wings are subject to availability. Boys and Girls (f2018, f2019, f2020,f2021): 1. Boys and Girls of batches f2019,f2020,f2021 will be allotted single occupancy rooms. 2. Girls of batch f2022 will not be allotted new hostels, and are expected to remain in their currently allocated rooms in Budh Bhawan. 3. NOTE: Wings can be of any size from 1-12 members, and you do not need to complete 12 members in your wing to be eligible for allocation. 4. Girls who are retaining their rooms allotted last year in Meera or Budh do not need to participate in the allotment process. Boys and Girls (f2022): 1. Wings should only be of even sizes. (eg. 2, 4, 6 … , 12 ) 2. Boys of F2022 will be allotted double sharing rooms, Girls of F2022 will be retaining their rooms in Budh Bhawan. -- 1 of 13 -- H2022: 1. Girls of H2022 who are retaining their rooms allotted last year do not need to participate in the allotment process. Do’s 1. Plan accordingly with your wingies before creating or joining a wing group. 2. Read the instructions carefully and all confirmations during the process to avoid any problems since all actions are irreversible. Don'ts 1. Do not mail the authorities or the Chief Warden with any queries or requests whatsoever. No such requests will be entertained. 2. Do not try to join wings of any other batch or gender. 3. Once the room is allotted no further changes are possible. Do not email any requests to change rooms or wings. Once the allotment is done it is considered final. To create a wing: After landing on the homepage, login using your respective BITS Email ID. NOTE: Before logging in, please make sure you have read all the instructions carefully since all of the actions are irreversible and cannot be undone. -- 2 of 13 -- After logging in you will be offered 3 choices 1) Create Wing 2) Join Wing 3) Opt Out of Hostel Allocation Opt Out of Hostel Allocation: Note: Once you have opted out, it is an irreversible action. You will not be allocated a room under any circumstances. Use this option with a lot of discretion. -- 3 of 13 -- Create Wing To create a wing, click on Create Wing button.
